title: i18n Translation Editor – Missing Keys & Inline Preview
description: See the translated text next to every t('key'), $t, i18n.t and <FormattedMessage id>, hover for every language, missing-key warnings per language, go to definition and a quick fix to add a key. Works with i18next, react-i18next, vue-i18n, next-intl and react-intl, JSON and YAML. Pro: translation tab

title: GALA
description: GALA language support: syntax highlighting plus the full GALA language server (`gala lsp`) — diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, references, completion, signature help, inlay hints and symbols.

title: pytest-queryguard
description: Shows the N+1 queries that pytest-queryguard found in the last test run on their lines: SQL, count and fix on hover.

title: Leggio
description: Reads markdown the way Leggio does: a calm look for the built-in preview, with diagrams, task lists, and your own fonts and colors.

title: Sass/SCSS Parameter Completion
description: Completes Sass function and mixin parameter names in SCSS, Sass, and Vue files.
